name: John Hall Buchanan, Jr.
summary: John Hall Buchanan Jr. (March 19, 1928 – March 5, 2018) was an American military veteran, clergyman, and politician who served as a Republican in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1965 to 1981, representing Alabama's 6th congressional district. He was one of five Republicans elected to the House in 1964, the first Republicans elected to Congress in Alabama since the end of Reconstruction.
